gt_summary: Frumkin-coverage Heyrovsky-Volmer: numerator 2*G_eq*(exp(1.5*f*eta)-exp(-0.5*f*eta)) divided by coverage denominator (G_eq*exp(g*f*eta)+1)+K_eq*(exp(g*f*eta)+G_eq), with Arrhenius T-scaling and activity terms G_eq~P_H2/c_acid, K_eq~1/c_acid
submission_summary: Plain Butler-Volmer: j0*P_H2*arrhenius*(exp(alpha_a*f*eta)-exp(-alpha_c*f*eta)) with alpha_c depending on c_acid^n, no coverage denominator
matched: Uses all four correct input variables (eta, T, P_H2, c_acid)
Arrhenius temperature dependence with similar Ea (~15-17 kJ/mol)
Correct sign convention (anodic minus cathodic exponentials)
missed: Entire HV coverage denominator is missing — the key mechanistic feature
Frumkin coverage exponent g on denominator potential terms absent
G_eq and K_eq equilibrium/activity terms in denominator absent
Fixed numerator exponents 1.5/0.5 replaced by fitted alpha_a/alpha_c
P_H2 and c_acid enter through activity ratios G_eq, K_eq in GT, not as linear/power prefactors
coefficient_assessment: Ea is in the right ballpark (~15 vs 17 kJ/mol), but the entire structural mechanism (denominator) is missing, making coefficient comparison moot for the dominant terms.
